parameters.name: Datetime
parameters.description: Date of sending, in the format yyyymmdd.

parameters.name: MessageId
parameters.description: Text message ID filter. The message ID is the ID returned upon successful execution of SendMessage.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: Page number, starting from 1. Default value is 1.

parameters.name: RequestId
parameters.description: Filter by text message batch processing ID. The batch processing ID is the RequestId returned upon successful SendMessage.

parameters.name: SignatureId
parameters.description: Signature ID. You can specify either the signature name or the signature ID, but not both.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
Text message sending status.  
- 0: Sending.  
- 1: Succeeded to Send.  
- 2: Failed to Send.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: Template ID. You can specify either the template code or the template ID, but not both.

parameters.name: TemplateType
parameters.description:
Filter by template type.  
- 0: Verification code.  
- 1: Notification.  
- 2: Promotional message.
